script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

Title: RESONANCE

INT. HOSPITAL - NIGHT

*Patients lay dormant in their beds, monitors beeping softly. The quiet hum of the hospital lingers in the still air.*

DR. LUCAS (30s, intelligent, caring)
(whispering to himself)
This is it... The moment of truth.

INT. DR. LUCAS' OFFICE - DAY

*Dr. Lucas, a brilliant neuroscientist, works tirelessly in his office. Surrounded by diagrams, books, and holographic displays. His assistant, AIMA (Artificial Intelligence Medical Assistant), is by his side.*

AIMA
(calmly)
Dr. Lucas, the subject, A-13, is stable. The procedure should commence shortly.

DR. LUCAS
(serious)
Proceed with caution, AIMA.

INT. CONTROL ROOM - NIGHT

*In the control room, a team of scientists, engineers, and technicians gather around a large holographic display. They all wear protective suits.*

TECH SPEAKS (50s, gruff, experienced)
(to the team)
Okay, everyone, double-check your connections. We're about to power up the neural amplifier.

INT. NEURAL AMPLIFIER ROOM - NIGHT

*In the neural amplifier room, Dr. Lucas approaches A-13, a man in a coma, connected to various machines.*

DR. LUCAS
(whispers)
You're not alone, A-13. We're going to give you a second chance.

INT. HOSPITAL - DAY

*After the procedure, A-13's brainwaves begin to show signs of life. Slowly, he starts to regain consciousness.*

A-13
(weakly)
Where... am I?

DR. LUCAS
(smiling)
You're in the hospital, A-13. You were in a terrible accident, but now you have a second chance.

INT. DR. LUCAS' OFFICE - NIGHT

*Dr. Lucas and A-13 sit facing each other in Dr. Lucas' office. A-13 looks confused and scared.*

A-13
Why did you do this for me? I don't deserve it.

DR. LUCAS
(calmly)
Deserve or not, you're still a human being worthy of forgiveness and a chance at a new life.

INT. HOSPITAL HALLWAY - NIGHT

*Dr. Lucas walks down the hallway, lost in thought. He bumps into XIAO MEI (20s, compassionate, caring), a nurse.*

XIAO MEI
(concerned)
Dr. Lucas, are you okay?

DR. LUCAS
(sighs)
Yes, Xiao Mei. Just a lot on my mind.

XIAO MEI
(softly)
You know you can always talk to me.

DR. LUCAS
(smiling)
Thank you, Xiao Mei. That means a lot.

INT. HOSPITAL CHAPLAIN'S OFFICE - DAY

*Dr. Lucas meets with the hospital chaplain to discuss A-13's case and the importance of forgiveness and second chances.*

CHAPLAIN
(wisely)
Forgiveness is a powerful thing, Dr. Lucas. It can heal wounds and mend relationships.

DR. LUCAS
(nodding)
I've come to understand that, chaplain. And I'm going to help A-13 do the same.

INT. HOSPITAL - DAY

*A-13, now recovered, sits in a wheelchair, looking out the window. Dr. Lucas and Xiao Mei enter, and they all share a warm moment of forgiveness and hope for the future.*

DR. LUCAS
(smiling)
You're going to be okay, A-13. And you're not alone.

A-13
(tearfully)
Thank you, Dr. Lucas, and Xiao Mei. I'll never forget this.

FADE OUT.
